crossRefs.note: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,
No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife.…
As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.
I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to…
I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God…
They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.
‘Hear this now, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes, and don’t see, who have ears, and don’t hear:
Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them…
for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
“Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” as for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
Cast away from you all your transgressions, in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new…
You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your help.

translations.web: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
translations.bsb: He who commits adultery lacks judgment; whoever does so destroys himself.
translations.kjv: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.
translations.asv: He that committeth adultery with a woman is void of understanding: He doeth it who would destroy his own soul.
